visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a young girl with dark bangs looking down at a small, fluffy white stuffed sheep toy on a white bed sheet. The lighting is warm and domestic. (2) A medium shot follows in a hotel room featuring a blue patterned wallpaper and a light wood headboard. The girl, wearing a white t-shirt, stands by the bed where several other plush animals are scattered. She looks worried and points at the bed. (3) A close-up shows a white notepad from 'VILLA FONTAINE' with Japanese handwriting and a hand-drawn illustration of the same sheep toy. (4) The girl is shown in a white robe, sitting and talking on a white hotel telephone handset with a concerned facial expression. (5) The scene shifts to a bright, wide hotel lobby with high ceilings and decorative light fixtures. The girl and another person walk toward a reception counter. (6) At the counter, a staff member's hands deliver a clear plastic bag containing the white sheep toy. The girl's expression transforms into one of intense joy and relief; she smiles widely and looks at the camera. (7) Finally, the girl is seen outdoors in bright daylight, holding the bagged toy and gesturing excitedly while walking along a paved path near some greenery.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a gentle, slightly melancholic acoustic piano melody and a female narrator speaking in Chinese with a calm, descriptive tone. (2) As the story progresses to the loss of the toy, the younger girl's voice is heard with a higher pitch and slightly anxious inflection, accompanied by the low ambient hum of a hotel room. (3) Upon entering the lobby, the piano music shifts to a more hopeful, major-key orchestral arrangement. A Japanese-speaking female voice is heard from the hotel staff, exhibiting very polite and rising intonations. (4) A sudden, high-arousal gasp and a joyful exclamation ('Oh my god!') from the girl coincide with the music swelling in volume and brightness. (5) The final phase features the sound of plastic bag rustling and layered, happy chatter between the girl and the narrator, underpinned by a triumphant, upbeat musical finale.
